name: Stranded & Naked
source: Your former school bully invites you to a party on a remote tropical island. After wandering off for some peace and falling asleep by a campfire, you wake up to find everyone gone. The party is over, the boats have left, and you’re stranded on the island. The only other person left with you is your bully. The only difference? You know how to survive... and she doesn’t.
